author: philly leader
title: Phillies announce schedule and events for Opening Day against Rangers
text:
The Philadelphia Phillies announced on Mar. 25 the full schedule of activities for their Opening Day game against the Texas Rangers at Citizens Bank Park.
Opening Day is a major event for both the team and its fans, marking the start of a new season and offering several traditions and celebrations. The day includes special ceremonies, giveaways, and performances to engage attendees.
The New Era Phillies Team Store will open at 9:00 a.m., featuring expanded space and merchandise celebrating both Opening Day and the upcoming 2026 All-Star Game. The store will close an hour before gates open at 1:45 p.m., then reopen for ticketed guests. All fans entering the ballpark will receive a 2025 National League East Champions Pennant, courtesy of Nemours Children’s Health. Batting practice begins with the Phillies at 1:25 p.m., followed by Rangers batting practice at 2:25 p.m.
Opening ceremonies are scheduled to begin at 3:30 p.m., including introductions of both teams. Kane Kalas, son of late Hall of Fame broadcaster Harry Kalas, will perform the national anthem near his father’s statue behind Section 141. A flyover by the New Jersey Air National Guard’s 177th Fighter Wing is planned after the anthem. Ceremonial first pitches will be thrown by Lucas Bibro—a patient from Nemours Children’s Hospital—alongside his cardiologist Dr. Mark Cartoski, caught by Phillies shortstop Trea Turner; former All-Star alumni Larry Bowa, Greg Luzinski, Mike Schmidt, and Ricky Bottalico will also participate in ceremonial first pitches to current Phillies All-Stars.
Game time is set for 4:15 p.m., with additional entertainment such as The Phillie Phanatic’s first dance during the fifth inning and a performance by The Philadelphia Boys Choir in the seventh inning.
Bag policies remain in effect with only small clutch purses or fanny packs (no larger than five inches by seven inches), clear bags (up to twelve inches by six inches by twelve inches), medical bags, or diaper bags permitted inside Citizens Bank Park.
Fans can also participate in an online auction for signed memorabilia from various players until April 24 through phillies.com/auctions.
The Philadelphia Phillies have won World Series titles in both 1980 and 2008 according to their official website. They represent Philadelphia in Major League Baseball while engaging fans through games and community outreach according to their official website. Since opening in 2004, home games have been played at Citizens Bank Park—a stadium spanning twenty-one acres according to their official website. The organization operates under executive leadership including its chief executive officer and general manager according to their official website.
Serving not just Philadelphia but also regional and national audiences according to their official website, the team remains one of Major League Baseball’s charter members within its National League division according to their official website.
